resources.string: Open Remora on your PC and scan its pairing QR code. Keep both screens visible to compare the confirmation code.
Allow camera access to scan the QR code.
The camera could not start. Check camera access and try again.

This PC is already paired. Remove the existing pairing before replacing it.
A biometric approval key could not be created. Enroll a strong biometric in device settings and try again.
The secure connection failed. Keep the PC online and generate a new pairing code.
Pairing was rejected on the PC.
The PC returned an invalid pairing response. Generate a new pairing code.
Pairing keys could not be saved securely. Generate a new pairing code and try again.
Pairing timed out. Generate a new pairing code on the PC.
